lines.text: The Spirit says some will abandon the faith in later times, and hypocritical liars will prohibit marriage and certain foods.
Everything God created is good, and nothing received with thanksgiving should be rejected, since God's word and prayer sanctify it.
Paul tells Timothy to reject silly myths and train for wisdom, which promises life now and in the next.
Timothy should set an example in speech, conduct, love, faith and purity, and devote himself to reading Scripture publicly.
